sinopsis.es: Freddy Lupin pertenece a una orgullosa familia de hombres lobo. Confiado de que pronto se convertirá en un hombre lobo de los más temidos, Freddy se queda sorprendido cuando descubre que no es todo lo feroz que esperaba.
sinopsis.en: Freddy Lupin, heir to a proud family line of werewolves, is in for a shock when on his 14th birthday his first 'warfing' goes awry, turning him into a ferocious poodle.  The pack elders give Freddy until the next moonrise to prove he has the heart of a wolf, or risk being cast out forever.  With the help of an unlikely ally in a streetwise stray named Batty, Freddy must prove he's 100% Wolf.
